requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement is fully resolvable. The ambiguity regarding the scope of filtering was resolved by interpreting 'filter network traffic between A and B' as filtering traffic traversing from A towards B, based on the context definition of filtering.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.

fields.condition: traffic traversing from the data-plane interfaces towards the management data traffic domain
fields.affected_element: data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing switches shall filter network traffic traversing from the data-plane interfaces towards the management data traffic domain.
structuring_notes: Decomposed based on the supported interpretation of AMB-01. The action is filtering traffic in transit.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: The specific mechanism of filtering (protocol/port inspection) is derived from the context definition but is not explicitly stated as a requirement constraint, so it is noted but not forced into the structure.
